parts.text: I am a full-time US employee (country_code=US, role=IC). How many weeks of paid parental leave am I eligible for after 14 months of tenure, and what is the policy citation?

eval_cases.context: Document DOC-US-PARENTAL-2026#sec-3.1 (country_code=US, min_role=IC): Full-time US employees with at least 12 consecutive months of service are eligible for 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave within 12 months of birth or adoption placement.
eval_cases.reference: You are eligible for 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave because you have completed at least 12 consecutive months of service [DOC-US-PARENTAL-2026#sec-3.1].

grounding_and_citation: States 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave accurately.
